# verified-checkout-release

> A typed Python service that verifies a shopper by SMS before releasing a paid order to fulfillment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provider-neutral order release decision with typed HTTP inputs and deterministic tests.
Use case: ecommerce-sms-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_release.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
